entries.value: Hello, I am the Glow, and I will be your companion for this adventure.
If you're on mobile, what you see at the bottom right of your screen is your drum. It is with this that you will be able to cast the spells you will learn later.
In our exchanges, I will refer to the top, middle, and bottom drums. If you're on a computer, these drums correspond to the 1, 2, and 3 keys on the top row of your keyboard.
Throughout your adventure, you will unlock various powers:
it will allow you to push green-glowing objects in front of you. To activate the power, tap your drums in the following order: [insert combo].
it will allow you to pull green-glowing objects toward you. To activate the power, tap your drums in the following order: [insert combo].
it will allow you to create up to 3 platforms. To activate the power, tap your drums in the following order: [insert combo].
Do this combo once to see where you will place the platform, and do it again to place it.
You will also find dull areas. You can activate the lanterns around these areas by passing next to them to help this world defend itself.
